_comment: Executable ingestion policy (constitution §سادسًا). Tunable limits live HERE (never buried in code); the exit suite reads them from this file, while NON-NEGOTIABLE constants stay literal inside the validator (ق22). Versioned alongside the constitution + exit suite. NOTE: the kernel matching policy is a SEPARATE registry (engine/kernel/policyRegistry.js); unifying the two is a later, explicit decision — not Part 1.

ingestion._exclusion_note: ONLY these explicit policy categories may auto-grant signed_exclusion (path ب, still reviewable). Deliberately NO set/gift/box/pack/sample/tester patterns — those risk excluding a real sellable bundle (ق4: bundles are independent results). Any ambiguity -> merchant review queue (ق19, path أ), never auto-exclude.

surface._comment: Leaf display caps for surface_reachable (4-b): how many SKUs a leaf actually SURFACES (1 primary + N alternates). Read from policy, never hardcoded in a test — a test-written cap is an estimate, not a measure. Stamped with policy_version.

authoring_tree._comment: Full-tree build limits (4-b). SEMANTIC stops (exact_pool<=leaf_primary_cap; no axis passes the gate) end branching for a REASON (ق12). The min_exact_option_ratio gate rejects a mostly-compromise (weakly-grounded) axis for BRANCHING — below it the axis is descriptive, not a question. The hard limits are a SAFETY NET only: exceeding them FAILS the build explicitly (never a silent truncation).
authoring_tree._axis_rule_note: v4 axis-selection law (consultation round-4). reduction = S - (Σsᵢ² + u₀²)/S, where S = the node's EXACT-pool size |E| (a NODE property, identical for every candidate axis at the node), sᵢ = per-option EXACT count, and u₀ = S - Σsᵢ is the explicit UNKNOWN-on-axis residual bucket. Because S is node-constant, ranking axes by max reduction == ranking by MIN integer (Σsᵢ² + u₀²) — no division/float/log (determinism + hash safety). Justification is EXPECTED RESIDUAL POOL SIZE (Σsᵢ²/S = Σ(sᵢ/S)·sᵢ), not a Gini index. Guards (all counts-only): reduction>0 strictly (kills a no-split single-value axis); MIRROR guard (median option size == 1, OR options/Σsᵢ > mirror_option_density_max) — a per-option-identifier axis scores the MAXIMUM reduction, so it MUST be gated by density, not by info-gain; and the existing min_exact_option_ratio gate. Tie-break order: fewer options -> smaller max sᵢ -> higher axis evidence degree (grounding coverage count) -> canonical axis id (last resort, never removed).
authoring_tree._unknown_axis_handling_note: For the info-gain accounting an UNGROUNDED value on the candidate axis is a SEPARATE residual bucket u₀ (excluded from every option size sᵢ), never propagated into the options. This is well-defined because an ungrounded value is NEVER `exact` (exact requires SAT requires grounded). The kernel's downstream CLASSIFICATION of such a unit stays mode-dependent and UNCHANGED (a NEVER_RELAX axis rejects it; a RELAXABLE axis compromises it into every branch) — that is the runtime partition, separate from this design-time axis-selection accounting. Invariant asserted at every node: Σsᵢ + u₀ == S == node exact-pool size.
